# Stellar Flare

Stellar Flare is Sunburst's mother, an ambitious unicorn mare from Sire's Hollow in the G4 television continuity of *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Think of her as the relentlessly organized parent who wants her son to succeed so badly that she forgets to let him choose his own future. She heads the town's Development Committee, often clashing with Firelight, Starlight Glimmer's preservation-minded father.

[![Hasbro Studios — Stellar Flare with Sunburst in The Parent Map](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/view/2020/7/23/2003751__safe_derpibooru%2Bimport_screencap_stellar%2Bflare_sunburst_pony_unicorn_the%2Bparent%2Bmap_discovery%2Bfamily%2Blogo_duo_faic_female_frown_male_mare_moth.png)](https://twibooru.org/2003751)

- **Appearance:** Orange coat with pale cream-colored markings, green eyes, a dark red bob, a pale blue headband, green beads and a blue pendant; her cutie mark is a yellow-orange sun with a spiral center. [Color guide](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/401-Stellar-Flare).
- **Name and voice:** Stellar Flare is an official credited name, not a fan invention. She was initially seen as Sunburst's unnamed mother in 2015; her speaking role in the May 5, 2018 episode *The Parent Map* credits Trish Pattendon. [Season 8 credits transcription](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Credits/Season_eight). She also appears as [Stellar Flare, Big Plans](https://data.mlpmerch.com/ccg/set/friends-forever/) on an Enterplay collectible card, and in [Gameloft's mobile game](https://mlp-gameloft.fandom.com/wiki/Stellar_Flare). No verified alternate identity was found.
- **Appearances:** *The Cutie Re-Mark – Part 2* (S5E26) and *The Crystalling – Part 1* (S6E1), both childhood flashbacks; *The Parent Map* (S8E8), her principal speaking role; and *The Ending of the End – Part 2* (S9E25), during the unicorns' retreat to the school in Canterlot and the final confrontation. [Family and appearance record](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Sunburst%27s_family).

**Fan artwork:** [Stellar Flare by AquaticVibes](https://www.deviantart.com/aquaticvibes/art/Stellar-Flare-945071250) (January 14, 2023), an independently drawn portrait showing her distinctive mane and sun cutie mark.

## Important moments

All three scenes are in *The Parent Map* (S8E8). [Official full episode](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K06KMkqGrb0) and [episode synopsis](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/The_Parent_Map). Exact timestamps are unavailable.

- **Development versus preservation** — S8E8: She agrees to hear the young ponies' objections to her modernization projects, showing how her determination to improve Sire's Hollow can blind her to others' wishes.
- **Manufacturing a friendship problem** — S8E8: She coaches local shopkeepers to pretend to quarrel so Sunburst can complete his mission, illustrating why her overhelpfulness drives him away.
- **Letting Sunburst find his own way** — S8E8: She explains that his failure at magic school left her worried about him, and accepts that he needs independence; their reconciliation completes his friendship mission.

Research note: The show still and artist's post were located and the still's direct asset was viewed. Some credits/wiki pages were available only through indexed excerpts; video playback and precise timestamps could not be verified.
